items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Hot Lips Page and about 15 musicians would come in and there was such a terrific arrangement that you'd just pull your hair out.

ctx.x: We worked every night from 9 till 12 and during the summer Tiny Brown's place was open. That's where Joe - the blues singer - Joe Turner and Pete Johnson were working. John would drive by and drop the boys off there and I'd go home and change from my sweaty outfit, take a bath. Oh, one thing I want to tell you. When we passed the place we'd hear "Georgia Brown". I'd go home, take a bath and dress and put on something cool and come back and they were still playing "Georgia Brown". But Hot Lips Page and about 15…
